description: This header file declares functions related to the 'sensord' daemon, including the main function and signal handler, for sensor daemon services within the Android HAL on a Linux-based system.

methods.name: sensord_main
methods.description: Entry point for the sensor daemon thread, processes sensor data or manages the sensor daemon lifecycle.

methods.name: sensord_sighandler
methods.description: Handles system signals for 'sensord', such as termination or interruption signals.
